title: Announcement visual kit: compact image pack & micro-mockups for release post
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, developer-focused image pack for the upcoming announcement blog and docs changelog. Deliver a small, lightweight set of assets that capture before/after UI comparisons, concise feature callouts, and social-ready variants. Assets should be optimized for web delivery, follow naming conventions, include alt-text drafts and localization-ready layers, and be exported to the shared CDN folder. This ticket is focused on the visual asset outputs (PNG/WebP/SVG) and export spec; copy writing and blog layout are handled in PM-2211.
deliverables: Hero banner - desktop (light + dark) - annotated source and exports
Before/After slider set - 3 feature comparisons (desktop + mobile)
Inline feature callout cards - 4x; compact 600x320 variants for docs
Social verticals - 9:16 story images for Twitter/LinkedIn/IG (3 sizes)
Micro animation frames - 6-frame stepper sprite for release preview (as PNG sequence + GIF)
Thumbnail pack - 120x120 and 320x180 for release index and docs header
Figma master file with organized component library and named export slices
acceptance_criteria: All desktop hero images exported at 1600x640 (1x) and 3200x1280 (2x) in PNG and WebP
Mobile hero and before/after exported at 900x1600 (vertical) in WebP and optimized PNG
Callouts include visible outlines and text at 16px minimum; color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text
SVG icons exported and named according to token convention: icon_featurename_light.svg / icon_featurename_dark.svg
Alt-text drafts included in a plain-text file (assets/alt_texts_release_2026-03.txt)
Localized layers available in Figma for en-US, fr-FR, de-DE (strings provided by PM-2211)
Files uploaded to CDN path and linked in this ticket; PM and ENG have provided approval via comment
Final Figma file versioned and published with release tag: release-visuals/2026-03
assets_export_specs: hero_mobile_vertical: 900x1600 (WebP, PNG fallback) - compressed - include safe-zone guides
before_after_desktop: 1200x700 (PNG slices for slider handle) - provide high/low res
callout_card_compact: 600x320 (PNG + WebP) + SVG source for text overlays
sprite_stepper: 6 PNG frames (320x120) + compiled GIF and optimized APNG for docs
